title: Self-Storage Has More US Locations Than Starbucks
closing: Storage's footprint shows how much physical space accumulated possessions now consume.
question: How much do you keep in storage?

segments.say: Self-storage reached 66 thousand US facilities, outnumbering each comparison chain shown.
Self-storage represents 57% of the combined total shown. Storage wins even after three large chains are grouped.
Self-storage reached 66 thousand facilities in the latest year. The footprint grew roughly tenfold across the series.
